data.one_liner: Create custom desktop windows and handle window operations on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter desktop plugin that lets developers remove standard OS titlebars, build custom window frames, and control window position, size, state, and visibility across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_when: You are building a Flutter desktop application for Windows, macOS, or Linux.
You need a custom window frame, titlebar, or custom window control buttons.
avoid_when: You are building a mobile or web-only application.
You prefer sticking to the standard OS-provided window titlebars and native buttons.
strengths: Cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Provides widgets for moving and resizing the window easily from Flutter UI.
Supports hiding the window on startup to prevent flickering.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration changes in native project files (C++, Swift, or C) for each platform.
data.setup_notes: Requires native code configuration changes in windows\runner\main.cpp, macos\runner\MainFlutterWindow.swift, and linux\my_application.cc.
